---
title: "📋 All-Time Match Results"
subtitle: "Search 3,100+ championship bouts from 2019 to 2026 by round, winner, method, and score."
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

source("_setup.R")

reactable(
  all_matches,
  theme = tbl_theme,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 15,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  pageSizeOptions = c(10, 15, 25, 50, 100),
  columns = list(
    year = colDef(name = "Year", width = 85, align = "center"),
    weight_class = colDef(name = "Weight", width = 90, align = "center"),
    round = colDef(name = "Round", minWidth = 140),
    winner = colDef(name = "Winner", minWidth = 140),
    winner_school = colDef(name = "Winner School", minWidth = 140),
    win_method = colDef(name = "Method", width = 110, align = "center", cell = badge_win_method),
    score = colDef(name = "Score / Time", minWidth = 100),
    loser = colDef(name = "Loser", minWidth = 140),
    loser_school = colDef(name = "Loser School", minWidth = 140)
  )
)
```
